answer: Bind each key to its own hardware enclave that seals a private running transcript. Every epoch, during a short tide window, the enclave must emit a remote-attestation quote chained to a public quartz nonce and to the previous quote. Chips that share platform measurements collide and collect as one lotus. An N-key farm must buy and keep online N distinct TEEs: one chip cannot mint N fresh measurement registers in the same window, and a missed or replayed quote burns that key's posted bond.
